title: Ask the Witch: Book of Answers
short: Ask a question, rub the cauldron and let the witch reveal your fate!
full:
Got a question on your mind? Ask the Witch! Think of your question, rub her bubbling cauldron with your finger and watch a magic scroll rise with your answer. A book of answers, a crystal ball and a fortune-telling witch, all in your pocket.

🔮 THREE WAYS TO ASK
• The Cauldron: rub it until the magic boils over and a scroll brings your answer.
• The Grimoire: hold the book, think of your question and let go. It opens at your page.
• The Crystal Ball: shake your phone or swirl the mist for a quick yes or no.

📜 200 ANSWERS
Wise, funny, mysterious and sometimes cheeky. Yes, no, wait, act now... each answer glows in its own color.

🌙 TODAY'S OMEN
A new omen every day with your lucky number, lucky color and lucky hour, plus the real phase of tonight's moon and what it means for you. Come back every day and keep your streak going.

✍️ ASK OUT LOUD OR IN SILENCE
Type your question or just think of it. Ask the same question twice on the same day and the witch will remember. Fate doesn't change its mind!

📖 FATE JOURNAL
Every reading is saved in your journal. Star your favorites and look back at what the witch told you.

💌 SHARE YOUR FATE
Send your answer to friends as a beautiful card and dare them to ask the witch too.

🐈‍⬛ A LIVING LAIR
A moonlit night, twinkling stars, drifting fog, a black cat and a witch with plenty to say. Tap around, there are surprises.

🌍 75 LANGUAGES
The witch speaks your language. Switch any time in the settings.

No sign-up needed.

For entertainment only: the witch is wise, but the decision is always yours.
